record.question: Hypertension is defined as BP more than:
record.explanation: Official final key: C — 140/90. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 4, printed Q28. Source limitation: Blood-pressure thresholds depend on the guideline and diagnostic setting. The question names no guideline or patient context; 130/80 and 140/90 each correspond to recognized thresholds in different frameworks. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
